hypotheses.justification: hB is used only through rank_kernels_meanClass → angularModel_contDiffOn / axialModel_contDiffOn. There shapedAmplitude_ne_zero supplies the condition hCn (C p ≠ 0) for FiveRowRank.deltaV_joint_contDiffOn / gamma_joint_contDiffOn. When B = 0 the result still holds. modelAmplitude coord 0 y = 0/(1+η^2) = 0, and because x/0 = 0 in Lean, angularDebt 0 d = ![0, -(d 0)/(2*0), d 2/0] = ![0,0,0] and axialDebt 0 d = ![0, -(d 1)/0] = ![0,0] for every d. So the H inside scaleFamily (angularFamily/desiredAxialFamily) becomes fun p => deltaV lam 0 a b 0 p.2 (resp. gamma …). This is ContDiff by FiveRowRank.deltaV_contDiff / gamma_contDiff composed with snd. scaleFamily_contDiffOn then applies, since it needs only ell and U smooth and ell ≠ 0 (modelLength = √y.1 > 0 on positiveTime). Hence angularModel_contDiffOn and axialModel_contDiffOn hold without hB, by splitting on whether B = 0. No other step uses hB: chartKernel_contDiffOn, chartKernel_finiteJetBounds, angular/axial_kernel_zero, meanClass_of_interior_support and chartAngular_eq_sum / chartAxial_eq_sum do not take it. So the theorem stays true and provable after deleting hB.
